method.label: Publicly advertised asking rents and move-in specials. Not signed lease transactions, not private rent-roll data, not pricing or legal advice.
method.net_effective_formula: asking rent x (1 - free months / 12) for weeks or months free; asking rent - dollar-off / 12 for dollar-off and look & lease; asking rent x (1 - pct x months / 12) for percent-off. Waived fees do not change rent.
method.concession_value: Largest concrete value in the advertised special ('up to', 'select units'), so the net-effective figure is the maximum advertised saving, not a guaranteed one.
method.already_net: Specials saying the advertised rate already reflects the concession are counted as concessions but never discounted twice.
method.concession_share_basis: Share of priced Apartments.com properties in the metro sample whose special matches the strict concession regex. Zumper has no specials field.
method.per_bed_filter: Floor plans with 2+ bedrooms advertised below 75% of the metro 1BR median, below the same property's cheapest 1BR, or named as student / co-living are excluded.
method.rent_cuts: A rent cut is the same listing id advertising a lower asking rent than its highest rent in the last 30 days. Shown only once 4 distinct ISO weeks of snapshots exist.
